notes.title: 🌀 Reflections of the Void — Demo Update Now Live! 🌀
notes.content:
We’ve just released an update for the Reflections of the Void demo! Based on your feedback, we’ve fixed several bugs and added some quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Fixes & Improvements:


 Fixed localization issue with the tablet after completing the test
 
 Dialogues can now be skipped with LMB
 
 You can now open the tablet using the middle mouse button
 
 Added a pause icon
 
 Mouse wheel now works for movement in the corridor
 
 Fixed a bug with background music not playing properly
 
 Fixed incorrect display of locked days
 
 Added a hotkey tutorial at the beginning of Day 1
 
 Removed interaction with the protagonist’s food
 
 Added a demo ending to the endings section
 
 Fixed a critical bug where pressing "Continue" after loading a save led to the death screen


Thank you for playing Reflections of the Void. Your feedback is helping us shape the experience.
